engineBridge.change: One opt-in researchPartialAddPolicy=ordinary flag, default original freeze. Reproduce all 28 F04 digests before new policies.

arming: One arm per flat-to-flat episode, first newly available completed5m observation while current actual depth>=6 and current gross inventory PnL<=-1.5%. Price-state sequence uses that closed5m tape only. Invalidate on actual flat/depth<6 or gross>=0 before action, missing5m sequence, or strictly after6h; no rearm. Existing ordinary exit priority retained. All broad rules have no MFI condition.
support: Freeze nearest confirmed support below arm bar close within3%, from SR context through that bar end with healthy14d coverage. Later close below level*0.999 establishes break. A strictly later5m bar touches boundary via high>=level*0.999 while closing below it; freeze its low. A still later5m close below retestLow*0.999 triggers. Close>=level*1.001 after break invalidates. No same-bar ordering inference.
rebound: Freeze prior completed15m high ending at/before arm bar end. Track running5m closing low since arm. First later5m close>=runningLow*1.005 but below frozen high establishes rebound; freeze that rebound bar low. A strictly later5m close<reboundLow*0.999 triggers. Close>=original frozen high invalidates. Only first rebound is followed, no optimized later peak.
buy_failure: After arm, first later5m observation with healthy HL15 ratio>=1.2 and closed price ROC15<=0 records ineffective buying and freezes its5m low. A strictly later5m close<that low*0.999 triggers; close>=that pressure bar high*1.001 invalidates. Flow window is at actual observation time, with source lag applied to availability, not event timestamps.
sell_oi: After arm, first later5m observation has healthy HL15<=0.85, ratio strictly lower than the snapshot at actual observation time minus5m, and healthy native asset OI1h>=0. Freeze its5m low; strictly later close below low*0.999 triggers; recovery above pressure high*1.001 invalidates. OI is native quantity, not marked USD value.
weeklyControls: Exact F04 MFI/weekly controller unchanged. Freeze-only turns its accepted trigger into an episode add veto, no sale. Half-ordinary sells half with original ordinary add permissions (no new signal/bypass). Original half+freeze is the repeated F04 control.
actions: Freeze-only becomes effective at decisionAt+actionDelay and vetoes otherwise approved adds until episode flat; no fake order or change to target/exit. Half uses causal next-open (plus delay) pro-rata reduction, keeps clocks/IDs and ordinary exit/SR priority; half_freeze retains original engine add lock only on actual fill. Unknown input invalidates only the pending experimental sequence, never liquidates or blocks normal protections. No rearm after a consumed signal.
runOrder: 28 F04 controls (all old cases) exact, then96 fresh variant paths: six non-HL policies x4models x3sensitivities plus4HL policies x2recent models x3. No full-history HL qualification; earlier lack of HL is not retrofilled. 10 new definitions, no unused budget filled.
limits: Already-mined overlapping windows, no independent holdout. Keep complete months/events including losers and recovered ladders, all counterfactual entry occupancy. HL missing/lag panels separate from economics; no floor weakening. Fixed taker fees; no maker, funding settlements, liquidation, shared account certification. No soft-stale/size/strategy/config/live change in this batch. No economic threshold changes after runs.
